about: Which years a state legislature meets in regular session, where it does not meet every year. A state with no row meets annually. Read from each state's constitution; the game reads it when a world begins, so no seed decides a legislature's calendar.

US-MT.source: Montana Constitution art. V, § 6: the legislature meets in regular session every odd-numbered year.

US-NV.source: Nevada Constitution art. 4, § 2: sessions are biennial and begin after the even-year election of members of the Assembly.

US-ND.source: North Dakota Constitution art. IV, § 7: the legislature meets in regular session every odd-numbered year.

US-TX.source: Texas Constitution art. III, § 5: the legislature meets in regular session every other year, in odd-numbered years.
